rules.accepted_credit_types: AAVSB RACE-approved courses and statutorily approved providers; classroom, conferences, seminars, interactive online and self-study
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE required for initial licensees (licensed in California for less than two years).
rules.alternatives: Inactive license needs no CE; reactivation needs 20 h in the prior 2 years.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; keep proof of CE for at least 4 years.
rules.notes: Max 4 h self-study/non-interactive online; online unlimited but at least 16 h must be interactive. CE earned in the 2 years before the license expiration date. No extensions.
rules.legal_basis: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code §4838; 16 CCR §2086 et seq.
